summary: BinPastes is a minimal pastebin service written in Java that lets you store and share text snippets. It includes features for client-side encryption, full-text search, and one-time messages.
goodFor: It suits small teams or individual users who want a straightforward, self-hosted text-sharing tool with added privacy features.
watchOut: The project has a low maintenance score and a modest user base, meaning you may need to patch bugs yourself.
deployNotes: As a Java application, it typically requires a Java runtime environment, persistent storage for your pastes, and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
